description: A man in a dark three-piece suit with a moustache leans over a desk, peering through a brass magnifying glass at a sheet of inked fingerprints. A metal pen-like tool is in his other hand. Behind him are wooden filing cabinets with stacks of bound papers on top and shelves of tied folders. On the desk are a rolling ink slab, an ink pot with lid, a roller, and crumpled cloth. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with warm lamplight, and the image fills the full frame with no border.
